correctness.rationale: The floor identity reduces F(n) for p∤n to gcd(n,t_(n mod p))=1, with F=0 on p multiples because k≥2. CRT proves pQ is a period, and no period can omit p or any ell|Q by constructing contradictory translated residue tests. Fiberwise coprime density is (1/p) sum phi(t_r)/t_r; power-residue coset identity follows from k-th power map. Expanding phi/t with the Möbius divisor sum, the principal term yields 1/zeta(2), and nonprincipal character sums by Polya–Vinogradov yield O_k((log p)^2/sqrt p); g=gcd(k,p-1)≤k controls uniformity. Independent exact floor/gcd and divisor-period checks for 48 triples matched. A finite check is not the proof of infinite p or uniform analytic bound.
residual_risks: Finite checks are corroboration, not infinite proof or priority proof.
